title: Conditional count on affected constraints
statement: For a finite domain $D$, a constraint multiset $C$, marginals $(\mu_v)_{v\in V}$, a variable $v_0\in V$, and a label $a\in D$, define the affected conditional count as the sum, with multiplicity, of the local expected satisfaction indicators over the constraints whose scopes contain $v_0$, using marginals with the $v_0$ marginal replaced by the point mass at $a$.
